note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #22, Q2 2024 Public Safety Perception) keeps the 51 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0624.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q2 data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_08 'Percepcion de seguridad en el cajero automatico localizado en la via publica'; BP1_6_1 'Hogar victima de robo total de vehiculo'; BP1_6_4 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de robo o asalto'; BP1_6_6 'Victima perteneciente al hogar de extorsion'; BP1_9_5 'Percepcion del grado de confianza en la Fuerza Aerea Mexicana'); 51/51 labels agree in content with the questionnaire sub-item/row carrying the same number, and catalogos/bp1_*.csv value labels agree with the printed option codes for every question. Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2024_q2safety_perception/counts.R): all 51 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q2 2024 CSV (24114 rows; live 1071913 rows over 24114 ids, 0 duplicate id-item) after the .do's recodes -- 204/204 item x level (1-4) counts identical, e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 10413/13618, bp1_3 1..4 = 6907/4755/7291/4567, bp1_6_1 1/2 = 560/23543, bp1_6_6 2656/21449, bp1_9_1 1..4 = 1250/6793/4001/3255. Dropped by the .do: code 9 everywhere, and code 3 'No aplica' for bp1_2_*, bp1_5_*, bp1_7_* (e.g. bp1_2_04 escuela 3=22355, bp1_7_1 3=4186). bp1_8_*/bp1_9_* are blank in the raw file for respondents who did not identify the authority in 1.7 (NA 8729/5707/3290/2492/11841/6204 = count of bp1_7_k != 1), per the questionnaire's skip rule. Q1-vs-Q2: Section I is identical to the Q1 2024 wave (batch_675) for 1.1-1.5 and 1.7-1.9 -- every shipped string, option and fill matches, so batch_675's English is reused verbatim for them. Question 1.6 is a DIFFERENT question: Q1 asked the three main ways of learning about public safety (14 0/1 indicators bp1_6_01..bp1_6_13, bp1_6_99); Q2 asks 'En los ultimos seis meses, algun integrante de este hogar, incluido(a) usted, sufrio la situacion ... de la tarjeta A?' over 6 incidences (vehicle theft, vehicle-part theft, burglary, street/transport robbery, other theft, extortion) as bp1_6_1..bp1_6_6 with 1=Si/2=No/9. The .do's own comment (lines 128-129) confirms 2024 Q2 has items 1-6. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered Q2 questionnaire wording (not the terser dictionary labels); all 66 distinct Spanish strings are exact substrings of the Q2 PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout and -raw, whitespace normalised), and a 110-dpi render of p.2 was read to confirm 1.1-1.6. Structure (batch_675 convention): CP1 read-aloud intro in instructions; one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2 and 1.4-1.9 the stem is in section_prompt and the sub-item/row in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 are single items with the stem in item_text. Kept as printed: '(LUGAR)', '(CIUDAD)', '(AUTORIDAD)', '(CODIGO DE LA INCIDENCIA)', 'la (al)', 'la (del)', 'la (el)' fills; '(a)'/'(as)' gender fills; trailing '?' and '...'; 1.1 and 1.3 options with their trailing '?'; the '[CDMX (3)]' row label on bp1_7_1 only; 'Otro' write-in row (bp1_5_5) as the bare word. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, entry boxes I__I, blank write-in lines, 'ESPECIFIQUE', interviewer directions (CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO; REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'A' Y REGISTRE...; PASA AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON; the 1.7 No-aplica and 1.8/1.9 skip notes; and the two 1.6 scope directions 'PARA LOS CODIGOS DE DELITO 1 Y 2 UNICAMENTE DEBERAS CONSIDERAR AQUELLOS VEHICULOS QUE SON PROPIEDAD DEL HOGAR' and 'PARA LOS CODIGOS DE DELITO 4, 5 Y 6 UNICAMENTE DEBERAS CONSIDERAR A LAS PERSONAS INTEGRANTES DEL HOGAR DE 18 ANOS Y MAS' -- interviewer-only, but they narrow what items 1-2 and 4-6 count). Tarjeta A (show card) is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed; the 1.6 item_text is the row text printed in the questionnaire. Options: printed labels mapped to the catalogo codes (identical in both); only levels present in the live data get rows (no row for 3 'No aplica' / 9 'No sabe / no responde', set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match Section I exactly (51 = 1.1, 1.2 x12, 1.3, 1.4 x8, 1.5 x5, 1.6 x6, 1.7-1.9 x6 each). Dictionary defect: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while the data and wording are the 2024 Q2 wave (file suffix 0624) -- same as the siblings; Description ('Urban safety perception ratings ... Q2 2024') does not mention that 1.6 is household crime victimization. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions (including the 1.6 notes limiting vehicle thefts to household-owned vehicles and incidents 4-6 to household members aged 18+), and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
